app.name: HB POS
bootstrap.title: Store checkout is being prepared
bootstrap.subtitle: Device approval, offline cash, peripherals and payment recovery are isolated behind durable contracts.
registration.title: Register this iPad for store checkout
registration.subtitle: This installation receives its own device identity. Approval, store access and cashier permissions continue to be managed by the existing HB POS backend.
registration.securityNote: Registration never reuses the WPF device record. Local credentials and the encrypted ledger remain bound to this iPad installation.
registration.formHint: Select the branch this iPad is requesting access to. The system generates its device code, and manager approval is required before checkout.
registration.pendingHint: Keep this screen open or return later. HB POS securely remembers the pending registration and checks again every five seconds while online.
registration.lockedHint: Checkout and new registration are disabled. Connect to the server and retry so HB POS can confirm the exact device state and safely finish recovery.
registration.storeLoadFailed: Branches could not be loaded. Check the network and try again.
registration.storeEmpty: There are no active branches available for registration.
registration.runtimeUnavailable: The encrypted runtime is not ready. Retry startup before registering.
registration.provisioningCodeHint: App Review or an administrator may provide this one-time code. Cashier sign-in still uses the assigned real employee barcode.
serverConnection.title: Server connection
serverConnection.confirmationHint: Pending local work is checked again. The address is saved and the POS runtime restarted only when the candidate server is reachable.
serverConnection.testPassed: Connection passed. This address can be used.
serverConnection.testFailed: Connection failed or the address is not trusted by this build.
serverConnection.saveBlocked: Connection testing is available during startup. Safe switching is enabled after the local ledger is ready.
serverConnection.saved: Server saved. Restarting the POS runtime.
serverConnection.saveFailed: Switch blocked or failed. The current server is retained when local work is pending.
